identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.02d][112.d] Integrate Layer 8 authority and delivery states into Observatory

values.summary: Prove dependencies and collision-free scope, obtain fresh design authority, bind #271, implement the narrow served-protocol adapter plus exact browser/scope proof and existing-runtime handler-output evidence, review, publish, and finish before #278 resumes.

steps.action: Validate terminal #112/#265/#270 dependencies, current-main base, exact scope, and collision freedom without binding or product edits.
Obtain fresh design review over the repaired design/card packet and bind #271 through typed v2 in FastWork only if the review passes.
Implement the Runtime-owned acknowledgement adapter and distinct accessible UI states within the exact three product/test paths.
Run existing real recipient_ack runtime proof, parse its nonzero denominator, and retain source-grounded authentic handler-output evidence as the browser fixture source.
Implement the literal eight-case browser wrapper with per-test nonzero assertions and zero/ignored/skipped/missing/duplicated case rejection.
Run exact validation, fresh exact-head implementation review, publication, CI, finish, and release #278 only after terminal ancestry.

invariants: Browser never becomes authority and never creates or holds private keys
Runtime-provided signed request and acknowledgement artifacts are opaque ephemeral POST inputs only and are never originated, rendered, logged, cached, or persisted by Observatory
Only Runtime status delivered is presented as delivery
Raw correlation identifiers and private authority material never render or persist
The browser proof consumes source-grounded authentic handler-output artifacts rather than mocked conversation frames
risks: Historical candidate mocked conversation results rather than the terminal #270 endpoint
UI could confuse accepted with delivered
Fixture-only proof could miss actual asset wiring
Private response fields could leak into DOM text
Runtime proof could report success with zero, ignored, skipped, missing, duplicated, or denominator-mismatched tests unless explicitly rejected
A new non-issue-local runtime wrapper script would violate #271 exact scope
stop_conditions: Any dependency cache is noncanonical or nonancestral
Any concurrent writer owns an exact changed path
Implementation requires Runtime/OpenAPI, index.html, or #278/#114 changes
Fresh review finds an actionable defect
Proof does not exercise the actual served response schema and actual Observatory assets
Wrapper evidence uses loopback-only or mocked conversation frames instead of authentic handler output
Any opaque signed request/acknowledgement material would render, log, cache, or persist
replan_triggers: Terminal dependency cache or ancestry drift
Fresh design review finds actionable design/card issues
Exact three-path scope cannot hold without changing Runtime/OpenAPI/index.html/#278/#114
